name: Glasgow City
title: Glasgow —
title_em: friendly, funny and full of music.
tagline: Victorian grandeur, Mackintosh, great museums and a sense of humour all its own.
summary: Glasgow is Scotland's biggest city, built on shipbuilding and trade on the River Clyde. It has some of the UK's finest Victorian architecture and a thriving music, art and sport scene.
The city has a strong Irish, Italian, Jewish and South Asian heritage as well as its Scottish one, and its Glasgow patter is known worldwide.

community.intro: Glaswegians are found in every part of the Scottish diaspora, and Glasgow's own mix of communities has produced a distinctive culture.

ancestry: Searching for your family's roots? ScotlandsPeople, the Scottish Government's genealogy service, holds statutory registers of births, marriages and deaths, census returns and Old Parish Registers.
